title: Recording a Signer's Certification From an Accepted Form: Occupancy and Residency Certification Desk Card
content:
Each signer's occupancy certification is recorded on the Occupancy and Residency Certification profile from an accepted certification form on file. This card governs the date a borrower's accepted **mailed** certification form stands on when it is recorded; the acceptance of the form and the signer's role and channel remain as the product's rules on certifications provide.

## Recording signers

Each signer is recorded once per cycle under the cycle's certification year, the calendar year of the due date the profile shows; a mailed certification form is recorded with its standing date under this rule as the date of the entry, and every other certification with its signature date as the date of the entry.

## Condition on the profile

> A mailed certification's standing date is fixed only after the profile shows no health-care absence under monitoring.

Said differently: while the profile still shows a health-care absence under monitoring, the standing date of a mailed certification is not fixed.

## Effect of recording

One certification entry is added to the profile's occupancy history for the signer named, citing the accepted certification form, with the signing channel, the date the certification stands on and the certification year given. The entry is copied with the profile's primary borrower and loan program; the profile itself is not changed.

## Invocation

`record_occupancy_certification_e8b1dc9f` is an agent-side tool: the servicing agent unlocks it, then calls it.

- `residency_profile_id` — reference number of the occupancy certification profile the certification is recorded on, as returned by the occupancy profile lookup; an identifier.
- `residency_submission_id` — reference number of the accepted occupancy certification form on file, as returned by the occupancy submission lookup; an identifier.
- `certifier_customer_id` — customer reference number of the person who signed the form, as shown on the form's submission record in the occupancy submission lookup; an identifier.
- `certification_method` — the channel the signed certification came through, exactly one of: `mail` (a signed paper form returned by post); `servicing_portal` (a certification signed in the online servicing portal); `phone` (a certification given by the signer on a recorded call); `not_applicable` (the value carried by history entries that are not certifications; it describes no signing channel).
- `effective_date` — the date the recorded certification stands on; a calendar date written YYYY-MM-DD, never empty.
- `certification_year` — the certification year the signature is recorded under; a four-digit calendar year (YYYY), an integer without decimals.

## Receipt

One line of the form "Certification <entry reference> recorded on profile <profile reference> for <signer reference>: <channel>, signed <date>, certification year <year>." The entry reference is the new history entry's reference number; its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the certification entry now exists.
